The suspect was charged with, resisting an officer without violence, disorderly intoxication
and battery.
The suspect was issued a $750 bond, which she later posted.
In court, the suspect's charges of disorderly intoxication and battery were dropped by the prosecutor.
She initially pleaded not guilty to the remaining charge of resisting an officer without
violence, but later amended her plea to no contest.
ordered to pay fines and court costs totaling $515.8. She later failed to pay the fines
and court costs, resulting in her Florida driver's license being suspended for four months
until the balance was paid in full.
